#### 🔎 网上核验（外部公开来源，不是群友发言）
- （02:00–03:00）Maya Bank Certificate｜Maya Help（2025-03-14）：Savings → Account details → Request a bank certificate；免费每日一次；含账户名/类型/后四位/币种/开户日/余额等 https://onevoyager.my.site.com/s/article/How-do-I-request-a-Bank-Certificate
- （04:00–05:00）Maya 注册需手机号验证｜Maya Create an Account（2026-10-18 查阅）：注册后向 registered number 发验证 SMS；Note: Your mobile number will be your official Maya account number https://www.maya.ph/create-account
- （04:00–05:00）Maya 海外/OFW 用菲律宾漫游号｜Maya OFWs-Use Abroad（2026-10-18 查阅）：填写 Philippine roaming SIM mobile number；验证 SMS 发到 registered Philippine roaming SIM number https://www.maya.ph/ofws
- （04:00–05:00）外籍护照可升级 KYC｜Maya Upgrade Account（2026-10-18 查阅）：For Foreign nationals 接受 Passport 作为 Primary ID；升级页未改写「须用菲律宾手机号开户」的注册前提 https://www.maya.ph/upgrade
